title: Specification reviewer input
description: The named data blocks the prompt assembly renders into the prompt of the specification reviewer. Each value is untrusted text and is rendered inside its own block; none of it becomes an instruction.

specification.description: The text of the draft specification as committed.

requirements_checklist.description: The requirements checklist, with the state of every item.

people_answers.description: What people answered when the specification asked them a question, from the factory's own record of their answers. A fixed sentence when nobody was asked.
